transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what made me finally come in is that... for the past few weeks, my eating has just been off. 

I’ll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to. And then at dinner, I just kind of pick at my food, even when my wife cooks a full meal. I've noticed my jeans are starting to feel pretty loose, so I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. Um, most days lately I just wake up with this... this heavy, flat feeling. It's like the apartment is just too quiet. Usually I'd play some music or something, but lately, even picking up my guitar doesn’t really lift me out of it.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Not really, no. I mean, like I said about the guitar, it just doesn't pull me out of the funk right now. But I haven't completely lost interest in it. 

I still want to do my usual stuff, and I still enjoy spending time with my wife or just watching a show. It's more just... that flat feeling is kind of sitting there in the background while I do them. So I wouldn't say I've lost interest overall.
Did something stressful happen in your life shortly before these changes started?

No, not really. Um... I've actually tried to figure that out myself, but nothing really stands out. Things have been pretty quiet, honestly. No big arguments or emergencies or anything like that before this flat feeling started. It just kind of... showed up.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

No, I haven't. I mean, I feel down and flat, like I said, but it's never gotten to that point. I don't have any thoughts about hurting myself or feeling like life isn't worth it. It's just a general low mood, not anything dangerous like that.
Are you avoiding food because you're worried about gaining weight?
No, not at all. I'm not worried about my weight or anything like that. I'm definitely not avoiding food. Just... yeah, that hasn't been an issue for me.
Have you been feeling less hungry than usual lately?

Yeah, actually. That's kind of what made me bring it up. For the past few weeks, my eating has just been... off. I'll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without even meaning to. And then I just pick at dinner, even when my wife cooks. I've even noticed my jeans are starting to feel a bit loose lately.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious or on edge lately?
No, not really. I wouldn't say I've been anxious or on edge. It's really just that low mood and the appetite stuff I mentioned. I haven't been feeling nervous or anything like that.
Have these low mood feelings been present nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yeah, it's been every day. This current low stretch has been going on for about three weeks now. It really started right after my wife settled into her new full-time work schedule.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

Yeah, a little bit. I mean, I am sleeping, but it’s just... broken up. I keep waking up around four or five in the morning, and my mind just goes straight to thinking about bills or some unfinished tracks I've been working on. After that, I can't really settle back down, so I end up feeling tired before the day even starts.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?

Well, mostly just what I mentioned about the mornings. Since I'm waking up so early, I start the day feeling pretty tired. But other than that, no, not really. I wouldn't say my energy is unusually low during the rest of the day, I'm just dealing with the lack of sleep.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?

Yeah, I have. Like, when I try to work on some code or arrange a song, I just... I keep rereading the same line over and over. Or I'll sit there replaying the same eight bars of a track, and I still can’t decide what to do next. It's just been really hard to focus and actually get anything done.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual lately?

Yeah, I guess so. Everything just feels... slower right now. Like, I'll sit there with my laptop open for ages before I even move my hands to type or plug in my MIDI keyboard. It just takes me longer to actually do anything.
Lately, have you been feeling worthless or unusually guilty?
No, I haven't really had that. I mean, I get a bit frustrated that I'm not getting much done right now, but... I wouldn't say I feel worthless. And no, no unusual guilt or anything like that.
Have you been feeling restless or unable to sit still lately?
No, not really. Honestly, it's kind of the opposite. I've mostly just been... sitting around a lot, like I mentioned before. I haven't felt fidgety or like I need to pace or anything like that.
During these past few weeks, has your appetite been lower than usual?

Yeah, actually. That's kind of what made me bring things up in the first place. For the past few weeks, my eating has just been... off. 

I'll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, just because I don't feel hungry. And then at dinner, I just kind of pick at my food, even when my wife cooks. I guess I've dropped a little weight from it, too, because my jeans are definitely starting to feel loose.
